deposits.notes: This is the primary paper's archive record, not a study-data deposit. The only original file is 0010.pdf; 0010.pdf.txt is automatically extracted article text, and 0010.pdf.jpg is an automatically generated thumbnail. The paper reports aggregate results and plots but supplies no participant-level records, individual arm assignments, individual outcome scores, participant idea texts, analysis code, or supplementary study materials. The three has_* fields refer to usable individual records, not aggregate descriptions in the article. The article's handle appears in the footer of PDF p. 1 (printed p. 95; markdown line 29). Both that handle and https://doi.org/10.24251/hicss.2026.013 returned HTTP 200 and resolved to https://scholarspace.manoa.hawaii.edu/items/a6779c1b-5088-4537-8df3-e8d45d974e0f. The publisher landing page has no supplementary data link. The DSpace item endpoint and complete bundles listing both returned HTTP 200: https://scholarspace.manoa.hawaii.edu/server/api/core/items/a6779c1b-5088-4537-8df3-e8d45d974e0f and the same endpoint followed by /bundles?size=100. Its three bundles are ORIGINAL, THUMBNAIL, and TEXT. Their file listings all returned HTTP 200: /server/api/core/bundles/fdc9a0cd-afff-4436-9082-df57ae5bed5e/bitstreams?size=100, /server/api/core/bundles/038b3efd-5f08-4063-b5d5-631e92284911/bitstreams?size=100, and /server/api/core/bundles/080794f0-4aa6-49e9-88b6-df53a29e8cbc/bitstreams?size=100 on the same ScholarSpace host. Each contains exactly one bitstream and has one result page. The article PDF download at https://scholarspace.manoa.hawaii.edu/bitstreams/62cb12b6-bbf1-4623-9086-c991b9151cdb/download returned HTTP 200; its 635556 bytes were read in memory and are byte-identical to the PDF on file (MD5 30bf056f5bca9c452ad040b1fe37ca92).

notes: Read the complete markdown conversion in chunks, lines 1-323, covering all nine PDF pages (printed pp. 95-103) through the end of the references. There is no appendix, data/code/materials availability statement, preregistration statement, supplementary-file statement, acknowledgement containing a repository link, or data-on-request offer; statements is therefore empty. The PDF has no embedded attachments or hyperlink annotations. The only printed URL is the article handle. The screening form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty. The one deposit listed documents the paper archive and its generated derivatives; it is not evidence of a public dataset, so the status is none_found rather than public_partial. All four requested repository APIs were successfully searched, including distinctive/full title queries and first-author searches. Initial Zenodo requests returned HTTP 400 for size=100; unauthenticated retries at the documented size=25 limit returned HTTP 200. All returned search records were reviewed; no relevant data deposit was identified. The unrelated OSF Proactivity Permission project is documented in searches and excluded from deposits. No participant/output data file was found, so no rows or columns could be inspected. None of final.open_items can be resolved from confirmed public data: the conflicting adjusted arm labels; randomized totals and arm-specific exclusions; exact scoring model, scale, and response aggregation; and the standard deviation/formula underlying the reported Cohen's d. Additional participant-level means, SDs, SEs, counts, and idea-diversity measures cannot be computed from an accessible dataset found in this check. This conclusion concerns the public sources searched and does not prove that no unindexed or private dataset exists. All network requests used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 and no credentials. Files examined online were kept in memory.
